title: Piaget counted a reach under the blanket as a sign the toy remained
summary: OpenStax says Piaget hid a toy under a blanket and treated a reach for it as a sign the infant knew the toy still existed.
body: OpenStax Psychology describes Piaget's check. A toy was shown, then hidden under a blanket. Infants who already had the understanding reached for the hidden toy. Infants who did not have it appeared confused. Reaching was the sign this passage uses. A longer look at a scene is not the measure described there.

sources.title: OpenStax Psychology, 9.2 Lifespan Theories
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Psychology web page, CC BY 4.0. Paraphrase; credit OpenStax. Supports the blanket-hiding description and the reach as Piaget's sign.
